items.q: There was another guy named Bob, had a place across the street, on 2nd Avenue over here.

ctx.x: So I'd come down there and play with Eddie and them, you know. Whoever he had regularly would be off, so

he'd call me and ask would I do it. There was another guy named Bob, had a place across the street, on 2nd Avenue over here. Oh, Jack Crystal had a place called -- I forget the name -- but anyhow, I used to play down there on Friday and Saturday. Sometimes he'd use Charlie and Red Allen and different trumpet players, you know. So then Joe Bushkin called me one day and says, "I'm going into the Embers for six weeks." I could go in with him.
